title: 申样书 XMind cases 1–79: executable-step repair audit
method: Case-by-case review against source wording, supported BrowserStep DSL and historical screenshot/independent E2E evidence. Only read-only page assertions and transient input edits are proposed. No steps are claimed executed in this audit.

cases.title: 在企微架构内的在职员工：直接授权登录，进入申请表单页，自动带出姓名/所属公司/部门
cases.remainingGap: These checks only prove the signed-in form is visible. To prove current WeCom identity/name/company/department is auto-filled, need an approved test account and expected identity fixture plus value assertions; screenshot does not show identity fields.
evidenceRefs: historical screenshot / independent runner where named in the gap

cases.title: 非本公司员工/不在企微架构：toast提示「暂无申请权限」，不进入表单
cases.remainingGap: Cannot test unauthorized employee with this authenticated employee session. Requires a dedicated unauthorized account or auth mock and verified denial route/toast; do not switch/clear the user login.
evidenceRefs: historical screenshot / independent runner where named in the gap

This proposed role assertion needs fresh locator confirmation; no submit is clicked. Also verify each invalid value is accepted by the input before interpreting the disabled assertion.
